correctness.rationale: Independent recursion over the six row choices gives complete face-size counts (36,360,1200,1224,288,0), total 3108 nonempty faces; parity of symbol sums excludes a full six-cell transversal. The fixed vertex-toggle matching has 1500 disjoint pairs and critical cells one in dimension 0, 23 in dimension 2 and 84 in dimension 3. Independent complete Hasse DAG topological sort traverses all 3108 faces. Constructed signed 23x84 integral Morse boundary matrix with 327 nonzero entries and exactly nine unit Smith factors. Since pi_2(wedge^23 S2)=Z^23, integral diagonalization cancels nine 2/3 pairs and leaves 14 two-spheres and 75 three-spheres. No inference from mod-two Betti numbers.
